note: Per-decision traceability for the ten West Virginia holdings in the national report, Q-040 to Q-049. Each row names the register question it became, the track it was verified against, the route contract it landed on, and the exact element of that contract that carries it. A holding with no named landing place is a holding nobody can check.
crosswalkRule: Position in an array is not identity. Every row was verified on jurisdiction, track, affected element, question-text hash and report-section hash before its holding was attached.

findingAboutTheContractNote.statement: The § 61-11-26 contract's note says 'Four report decisions land on this one route: no residence-county venue, no single receiving court for a multi-county group, omit or sever an excluded conviction, and the current thirty-day reply period.' Six do.
theTwoItOmits: Q-044 / register Q-051 — the nonviolent-felony characterisation, which is carried by failure disposition wv_61_11_26_nonviolent_felony_characterisation.
Q-045 / register Q-052 — the correct form, which is carried by delivery gate wv_61_11_26_sca_c906_artifact_review.
findingAboutTheContractNote.whyItMatters: Both omitted holdings ARE implemented in the contract. The defect is the count, not the coverage — but an undercount is how a holding stops being reviewed: nobody looks for a fifth and sixth decision on a route the note says carries four.

decisions.holding: Job-readiness completion is an OR trigger for the accelerated clock, independent of ninety days of treatment compliance, and it is available for a single misdemeanor only.
landsOn: exclusion: the accelerated trigger is single-misdemeanor only

decisions.holding: There is no residence-county venue option. Subsections (a)(1) and (a)(2) both direct the petition to the circuit court in which the conviction occurred.
landsOn: exclusion: there is no residence-county venue option

decisions.holding: A multi-county conviction group has no single receiving court.
An excluded conviction inside a group must be omitted or severed rather than carried, and the once-per-lifetime rule means a wrongly-composed petition is not simply refiled.
Whether a felony is nonviolent for this section is a characterisation a participant must not be asked to make alone.
decisions.note: One of the two the contract's own note leaves out of its count of four.

decisions.holding: The correct petition form for this route is SCA-C906, and its currency is an artifact question.
decisions.note: The other of the two the contract's own note leaves out of its count of four.

decisions.holding: The current reply period is thirty days.
landsOn: released as packet content, per the contract note
decisions.openItem: This is the only one of the six that lands on packet content rather than on a contract element a verifier can read. It becomes checkable when the § 61-11-26 packet specification exists, and until then it is asserted rather than proven.

decisions.holding: The legal answer is settled and the published SCA-C903 form is stale. That is an artifact question, not unresolved research, and must not be sent to counsel as though it were.
The same stale-form finding covers the diversion and deferred-adjudication branch.
decisions.note: Two report questions, two tracks, one gate. That is correct here because the finding is about one form; it is recorded so the shared landing is a decision rather than an accident.

decisions.holding: § 5-1-16a(b) provides only that the expunged record may not be considered by a West Virginia educational institution or in an application for a licence required by a West Virginia professional organisation. Unlike §§ 61-11-25(e) and 61-11-26(l) it carries no general non-disclosure provision, so the guidance must describe the effect it actually has.
landsOn: packetFamily null — the route is guidance, not a packet
